text_block_list.name: Sports Nutrition Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is split into groups of four, 
yes? Now then, please pay close attention 
to nutritional balance and hygiene as you 
begin the cooking practicum.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The dish to make is hamburg steak, huh. 
Understood. I will have it ready in record 
time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Sautéed onions, milk, and breadcrumbs... 
Looks like we've got everything ready 
according to the recipe.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Okay~. Then after this, we just mix in the 
minced meat and—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Seasoning, huh. In that case, it's noodle 
soup base's time to shine!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, that wasn't in the recipe, was 
it!? And you put in a crazy amount too!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Noodle broth base is incredible. It's an 
all-purpose seasoning in just one bottle.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Portion sizes are all about feeling. I 
don't have time to mess around with 
measuring spoons. Not if I want to finish 
as fast as possible.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't even aiming for the fastest time, 
you know?! Umm, is this really okay...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Well now, in that case, let's use less 
milk and put half the breadcrumbs in 
first. The breadcrumbs will soak up the 
moisture, so it'll be just fine."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! Then let's split the batter into 
one with milk and one with noodle soup 
base!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Will you pull a 'classic' or an 
'oddball'? The fun's in findin' out once 
ya take a bite, y'know."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the way those veggies are shaped is 
so photogenic. As expected of Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the side dishes are important too, 
after all. Yours is lovely too, 
Jordan-chan. Now then, the next vegetable 
is—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "Don't worry. I minced every last bit."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Why!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Mix it with meat, and you get all your 
vegetable nutrients in one bite! It's a 
quick and easy complete-meal hamburg 
steak!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Using a food processor to chop everything 
saves an overwhelming amount of time. 
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No, I told you I was making a side dish! 
Why would you mix it into the hamburg 
steak?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I suppose I'll turn these 
minced veggies into a coleslaw.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll give it a spicy flavor. 
Nakayama-chan, could you help me with 
that? You love spicy food, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, works for me. I'll make something 
that'll give ya chills.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, almost there! All that's left is 
to bake it, right?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I will not cut any corners 
until the end. If we are to grill meat—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Sear it quickly over high heat!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that heat is way too high! At this 
rate, it's gonna ruin it...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Calstone-chan! When I give the signal, 
flip it over real fast, okay!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ready, and... Now!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Next, we steam-fry it on low heat to cook 
it through. ...Hehe, since it was seared 
on high heat, it's sure to be full of 
juicy goodness inside!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, really? Then let's keep grilling. Give 
me the signal again, Acute.

"In the cafeteria, I spotted Calstone 
Light O and her classmates. They appeared 
to be eating hamburg steaks."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~, whoops. Our hamburg steaks look 
totally different from everyone else's. 
But... ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, not bad at all. With a 
never-before-tasted deliciousness like 
this, we definitely won our bet!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It's probably because I was with 
Right O-chan, huh.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I only focused on making it 
fast, but I'm glad to hear it's delicious.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I barely ever cook, you know. It turned 
out so good even I'm surprised.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That was Jordan, right?! So why was she 
sprinting like that!?
choice_data_list:
I wonder if this is the result of everyone 
joining forces.
What do you do when you have to cook?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's true. If I were on my own, I 
could never make such a proper, wholesome 
meal.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Delicious, nutritious, and above all, 
fast! This truly is the ideal dish.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, I'm glad to hear that. Then 
Light O-chan, let's make it together 
again."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I generally don't cook. Buying food is 
faster, after all.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
As for cooking, which I do on very rare 
occasions... I cut a French baguette in 
half. Then I spread jam on it. And the jam 
bread is complete.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Doesn't that not even count as cooking?
